llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The change adds a context parameter to the storage.Queryable interface's Querier method, requiring updates across three repositories (Prometheus, Thanos, Mimir). All implementations of this interface and their callers must be modified to pass the context through the call chain, enabling future support for cancellation and deadlines.

FILES:
- prometheus/storage/interface.go — Defines the Queryable interface and QueryableFunc adapter that must be updated
- prometheus/tsdb/db.go — Primary implementation site for DB.Querier and DBReadOnly.Querier methods
- prometheus/storage/fanout.go — Implements Querier that calls both primary and secondary queryables
- prometheus/storage/remote/storage.go — Storage.Querier implementation that calls underlying queryable
- prometheus/storage/remote/read.go — sampleAndChunkQueryableClient.Querier implementation
- prometheus/web/api/testhelpers/mocks.go — FakeQueryable test mock implementation
- thanos/pkg/receive/multitsdb.go — ReadyStorage and adapter Querier implementations
- mimir/pkg/ingester/user_tsdb.go — userTSDB.Querier wrapper implementation
- mimir/pkg/storage/lazyquery/lazyquery.go — LazyQueryable.Querier implementation
